# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 9 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 9:3 — Woe is me vs. Woe to me

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Woe is me" | Standard English idiom |
| LOGOS | "Woe to me" | More literal vae mihi — Latin dative |
| PNEUMA | "I have failed" | Paraphrase; loses the exclamation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS 'Woe to me' is more precise to the Latin vae mihi. 'Woe is me' (EMET) is a common English form but the dative construction of the original is better rendered 'Woe to me.' PNEUMA loses the lament entirely. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
